cases.name: Karla Gail Arnold
cases.about: Her obituary said, Karla, better known as “Ya-Ya” was loved by all who knew her and brought much joy into everyone’s life. Her infectious smile and humor are best described by the verse “a merry heart doeth good like a medicine” (Proverbs 17:22). She was an active member and faithful servant at Bible Baptist Church, and she enjoyed working with the Senior Saints group at church. The love of her life were her grandchildren with whom she shared many a treasured moment.
